title_en: Huang Jincheng and 24 Others v. Chengdu Wuhou District Housing Administration Bureau — administrative dispute over division of property management area
ruling_gist_en: According to Article 54(2)(1) of the Administrative Procedure Law, if there is no evidence that the administrative agency, when dividing the property management area, has considered the ownership, use, and maintenance of the common facilities and equipment in accordance with Article 9(2) of the Property Management Regulations, the court shall render a judgment to revoke the administrative act and order the administrative agency to make a new specific administrative act.
